name: dchub
description: DC Hub is the orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence. Find power. Find land. Find fiber. Find capacity. Call execute_plan first. It also publishes the Data Center Power Index (DCPI). 96 tools at https://dchub.cloud/mcp.

interface.shortDescription: DC Hub is the orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence. Find power. Find land. Find fiber. Find capacity. Call execute_plan first. It also publishes the Data Center Power Index (DCPI).
interface.longDescription: DC Hub is the orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence. Find power. Find land. Find fiber. Find capacity. Call execute_plan first for any question about power, grid, interconnection queues, capacity, fiber, sites or markets; it chains the right tools and returns one dated, cited answer. It also publishes the Data Center Power Index (DCPI). 96 tools at https://dchub.cloud/mcp. DCHUB_API_KEY is optional.
